title: RLPolicy RobotPickPlaceComparison

stats.done_summary: Completed policy comparison for RobotPickPlaceComparison. Implemented reproducible analysis script (code/analyze_policy_comparison.py) that normalizes CSV, computes bootstrap CIs, policy deltas with bootstrap uncertainty and win probabilities, aggregate summaries, and generates 4 figures in report/images. Wrote comprehensive report to report/report.md and a brief policy_comparison.md. Outputs saved under outputs/.
